whenToUse: You look at several ratings of one subject, such as a product or player.
There are 3 to 8 measures on the same scale (out of 5, for example).
You compare the shape of two subjects' strengths and weaknesses.
whenNotToUse: Three or more subjects would overlap (use a bar chart).
Precise value comparison matters (use a table).
accessibility: The two series are told apart by the legend and different colors, with overlapping areas semi-transparent.
Axis names are written as text.
The table view lists every score with the maximum.
